jobs.title: Associate Technical Support Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Experience: 3 to 6 years</p><p>Good understanding of backup and recovery concepts</p><p>Administrative experience in Operating Systems - Windows, Linux/Unix</p><p>Knowledge of cloud infrastructure - AWS</p><p>Working knowledge of Active Directory and API</p>
